risk_note: RV2 by path. Settlement records written in production for the first time (D10-583 S1, FU-PROD-WIRING item 13): the sync path writes order_settlements with source API, seq under the order lock, one more row only when the content differs, created_at from the Clock, before rebate.onUpdated; first import at P12 too. orders.settle_commission_fen follows BR-FUND-09: the latest STATEMENT if any, so API never overwrites it; orders.union_settled_at now has a writer, so the expected credit month takes the union's. Only the record behind the column absorbs rights deductions. A P12 snapshot values on the settlement amount. settlement writes the records, orders writes its columns. Not enough alone: no adapter reports a settlement amount in production yet (CAP-PDD-07, FU-SETTLE-STATEMENT-IMPORT, CAP-TB-07), so this closes only the missing writer. Clawback's readLatestSettlementAt is left to B2-04zi. No contract, no migration.
